verdict.rationale: Smithery has a first-party Vercel AI SDK integration page. It covers OAuth, token refresh, connection management and aggregating tools across multiple servers, so a documented adapter exists for one major framework. There is no evidence of documented adapters for the other frameworks the story names. missing for 10: LangChain adapter docs, CrewAI adapter docs, OpenAI SDK adapter docs, Anthropic SDK adapter docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of the Vercel AI SDK integration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug the platform's tools into major agent frameworks and SDKs (Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs) with documented adapters

citations.quote: Smithery handles OAuth, token refresh, and connection management automatically.
Connect to multiple servers and aggregate their tools
